questions.q: In which year did Tom Hiddleston first appear as Loki in a Marvel film?
questions.why: Hiddleston debuted as Loki in the first Thor film in 2011 and has reprised the role in many MCU titles since.

questions.q: Loki's scheme of manipulating the Hulk led to the formation of which hero team?
questions.why: In the comics, Loki's plot to frame the Hulk pulled several heroes together, who then stayed on as the Avengers.

questions.q: In the comics, Loki grew up in which realm?
questions.why: Odin took Loki in as an infant and raised him in Asgard alongside Thor, though the boy was born a Frost Giant.

questions.q: Loki's earliest modern clash with Thor on Earth comes after he escapes from what?
questions.why: Loki gets free of the tree and squares off against Thor on Earth; Thor pulls him from the water, then hurls him home to Asgard.

questions.q: Which legendary artist redesigned Loki and drew his Silver Age debut?
questions.why: Jack Kirby penciled the modern Loki's debut and gave him the look that defined the Silver Age version.

questions.q: In the 2021 Disney+ series Loki, which variant is the show's Lady Loki?
questions.why: Episode two of the show reveals Sylvie as a female Loki variant, a nod to Lady Loki from the comics.

questions.q: In which 1962 comic did the modern, Silver Age Loki debut?
questions.why: The Silver Age Loki first appeared in Journey into Mystery #85, a few issues after Thor himself arrived.

questions.q: An earlier version of Loki appeared in Venus #6, published in which year?
questions.why: A Loki appeared in Venus #6 in 1949, long before the Thor-era version created in 1962.

questions.q: Which writer, with artist Jamie McKelvie, wrote the 2010 one-shot Siege: Loki?
questions.why: Kieron Gillen wrote Siege: Loki #1 with art by Jamie McKelvie, and later made a child Loki a lead character.

questions.q: Which team did Kid Loki join in the 2013 relaunch of its series?
questions.why: Kid Loki became a member of Young Avengers in the 2013 relaunch, alongside Wiccan and Hulkling.
